rule: Every headword that the CEFR-J Wordlist 1.5 grades A1 (any part of speech) is selected. NGSL 1.2 supplies frequency order and attribution only. The current catalogue is compared, never used to select.
citation: The CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.5. Compiled by Yukio Tono, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies. Retrieved from https://github.com/openlanguageprofiles/olp-en-cefrj (commit d4e45b75b38f27b30dfc5c44d8c571aec7e7092f).
